entries.title: Build report
entries.text: Opens the build's report on GitHub: what was built, the tests and the known gaps.

entries.title: Mark unread
entries.text: Puts this feature back on the unread count, so the banner shows it again.

entries.title: Mark read
entries.text: Takes this feature off the unread count. Opening a feature marks it read too.

entries.title: Mark all read
entries.text: Marks everything in the list read; the banner count goes to zero.

entries.title: Check now
entries.text: Rebuilds the list from what merged to main right now, instead of waiting for the next check.

entries.title: Search
entries.text: Narrows the list as you type. Every word must match the title, summary, build, app or PR number.

entries.title: Group
entries.text: Groups the list by date (Today, Yesterday, This week, Older), by build or by app. Your pick is remembered on this device.

entries.title: How far back
entries.text: How many days of merged features the banner and the panel show.

entries.title: Only what is deployed
entries.text: On: only features a deploy has carried out since they merged. Off: everything merged to main.

entries.title: Include every app
entries.text: Clears the app picks so features from every app, plugin and the framework show.

entries.title: Back to the defaults
entries.text: Goes back to 30 days, every app, merged and deployed both shown.

entries.title: Show What's new on the banner
entries.text: Shows or hides the What's new ticker on the banner on this device. The panel stays in the Builds menu.

entries.title: Step through the unread titles
entries.text: On: the banner rotates through the unread feature titles every few seconds. Off: it shows only the newest one.

entries.title: What's new
entries.text: Settings for the What's new banner: what it shows and whether it is on the banner.

entries.title: Show what's new
entries.text: Opens the What's new panel: every feature merged to main, grouped by date, build or app.

entries.title: Mark all read
entries.text: Marks every feature in What's new read.

entries.title: Check now
entries.text: Rebuilds What's new from the latest merges.
